TEXT: And so, on the day of Comiket---

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hi～, we're selling a new doujin～, However, the content is full of ramblings by a chuunibyou so it's pretty pitiful～

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ah, however the drawings are still at a viewable level～?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: If that's acceptable for you, then please do come and buy～. This cat will be really happy if you do～

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You... Are you here to put me down or to help promote my items?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Oh? I'm not putting you down. I'm seriously helping you promote your items.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I'm just hoping nobody gets scammed into buying, so I'm just explaining in detail what they're going to buy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Heh? Using slander to promote the things that I'm selling, congratulations on having such a brain. Is this what they call trend snobbishness?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: To think you would want to sell such a manga. This is why chuunibyous are painful to be with.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: They just don't grow up mentally at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Now, now, the both of you... Today is such a delightful day, I know both of you are on good terms, but do have a limit on the lover's quarrel...
Kuroneko completed her manga, Today... At last the usual member's daily routines are finally back.
In hindsight, have they really been fighting until now? It's what I've been wondering.
From what it appears, it truly feels like the usual scene.
...Well, I've worked so hard just for the sake of seeing this scene.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: By the way, I have something that I have to tell you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh, what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Ah? S-Sorry, I didn't quite hear you... could you say it once more?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Once more? Don't joke with me. You just missed the chance that only comes once in a lifetime.
Although that's what she's saying... From her expression, I could roughly guess what Kuroneko just said.
For the shy Kuroneko, it is indeed not easy to repeat what she had just said.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'll listen more carefully next time. Let's continue working hard from now on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Do as you please. I'll tell you again when I feel like it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, I'm counting on you.
That sentence Kuroneko said was...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ---Thank you---
